name: Sched
description: Sched is an event scheduling and audience-engagement platform for managing sessions, speakers, sponsors, exhibitors, attendee agendas, registration, check-in, communications and event websites and apps.
agentUseSummary: Sched is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not connect while the documented API transmits an event API key in URL query strings and lacks a scoped multi-event authorization lifecycle.

capabilities.label: Access authorized schedule data
capabilities.description: If Sched publishes a header-based scoped contract, expose only reviewed schedule capabilities for the selected event.

blocked.label: Send API keys in URLs
blocked.description: Relay will not place an event API key in URL query strings where logs, intermediaries or diagnostics can retain it.

blocked.label: Expose attendee and speaker data
blocked.description: Attendee, speaker, sponsor, exhibitor, profile, registration and check-in data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Sched mutations
blocked.description: Session, speaker, user, sponsor, exhibitor, venue and other writes are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Sched actions before security review
blocked.description: No export or mutation is callable until Sched documents secure header authentication, scopes, key lifecycle, limits and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Security review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable under Sched's current URL-query API-key contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Sched's current query-key contract.
No Hermes tools are callable under Sched's current query-key contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Sched's official API reference sends the per-event secret in the api_key URL query parameter. The public materials do not document header authentication, scopes, rotation/revocation semantics, cross-event tenant binding or a distributable third-party authorization flow.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Sched for a production header-based authorization contract with event/tenant scopes, key lifecycle, rate limits and third-party distribution terms. Re-run product and security review after publication.

evidence.supports: Sched's official API reference documents event API methods and examples that include the secret api_key directly in the URL query string.
Sched describes its API as an organizer integration surface and directs customers to event-specific API access.
Sched instructs organizers to obtain an event API key from the speaker export area and documents API-based speaker creation, demonstrating both people-data and mutation authority.
